title: Shared definitions
description: Identifiers, timestamps and small value types shared by every contract schema. See contract/README.md for semantics.

node.description: Mesh node name, the `<node>` part of a `<node>-<agent>` identity. No hyphen, so the first hyphen of a mesh id always ends the node.

suffix.description: Agent suffix, the `<agent>` part of a `<node>-<agent>` identity (culture.yaml `suffix`).

mesh_id.description: A mesh identity in `<node>-<agent>` form, used for agents and for principals (operators and agents).

ulid.description: A ULID: 26 Crockford base32 characters, uppercase.

run_id.description: Stable run id: `<node>-<agent>.run.<ULID>`, where `<node>-<agent>` is the executing agent's mesh id.

action_id.description: Stable control-action id: `<node>-<agent>.act.<ULID>`, using the target run's agent.

harness_id.description: Harness identifier, a free lowercase string (for example `claude-code`, `opencode`). Deliberately not an enum.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.

nullable_timestamp.description: A timestamp (same pattern as `timestamp`) or null.

repo_path.description: Absolute POSIX path of a repository on the core's host, with no `.` or `..` segments, no trailing slash and no control characters (a newline would hide a `..` segment from the pattern).

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen key, recorded and returned. D1 does not deduplicate on it (see README).

cursor.description: Per-run event cursor: the first event is 1 and each next event is exactly 1 higher.

text.description: Free text from a caller (task, steer message). Untrusted data, never a control command.

principal.description: Who asked: an operator or an agent, by mesh id. In D1 the core records it as supplied; authority comes from the owner-only socket and the allow-list, not from this field.

extension.description: The single opaque field for harness-specific data. Consumers must not depend on its contents, must not branch control flow on it, and must treat it as untrusted. Its shape is outside the contract and is not versioned.
